item.title: ABCP Market Makes Comeback as Banks Seek Balance-Sheet Relief
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg Markets
item.description: Asset-backed commercial paper, blamed for amplifying the 2008 financial crisis, is making a comeback as banks turn to the short-term funding market to do more business with less strain on their balance sheet.
